query:
INSERT INTO rulesDatabase (ruleCode, codeVersion, jurisdiction, title, description, category, nbcReference, ruleData, isActive, effectiveDate, createdBy, version) VALUES
('EGR-001', 'NBC_2025', 'Canada', 'Number of Exits Required', 'Minimum number of exits based on occupant load and occupancy type.', 'EGRESS', 'NBC 3.4.1.1', '{"minExits":{"occupantLoad":[0,50,500,1000],"exits":[1,2,3,4]},"notes":"Occupant load determines minimum number of exits"}', true, NOW(), 1, 1),
('EGR-002', 'NBC_2025', 'Canada', 'Travel Distance to Exit', 'Maximum permitted travel distance from any point to the nearest exit.', 'EGRESS', 'NBC 3.4.1.2', '{"maxTravelDistance":{"residential":30,"commercial":40,"industrial":50},"notes":"Travel distance measured along floor level"}', true, NOW(), 1, 1),
('EGR-003', 'NBC_2025', 'Canada', 'Exit Door Width Requirements', 'Minimum width of exit doors based on occupancy type.', 'EGRESS', 'NBC 3.4.2.1', '{"minWidth":0.9,"accessibility":1.0,"notes":"Width measured clear of frame"}', true, NOW(), 1, 1),
('EGR-004', 'NBC_2025', 'Canada', 'Stair Dimensions - Rise and Run', 'Maximum riser height and minimum tread depth for stairs.', 'EGRESS', 'NBC 3.4.6.5', '{"maxRiserHeight":200,"minTreadDepth":280,"tolerance":6,"notes":"Riser height measured vertically, tread depth measured horizontally"}', true, NOW(), 1, 1),
('FS-001', 'NBC_2025', 'Canada', 'Fire Alarm System Requirements', 'Buildings must be equipped with fire alarm systems based on occupancy and size.', 'FIRE_SAFETY', 'NBC 3.2.4.1', '{"required":{"residential":{"area":2000,"storeys":4},"commercial":{"area":500,"storeys":2},"industrial":{"area":1000,"storeys":2}},"notes":"Thresholds are cumulative"}', true, NOW(), 1, 1),
('FS-002', 'NBC_2025', 'Canada', 'Sprinkler System Requirements', 'Automatic sprinkler systems required in certain occupancies and building sizes.', 'FIRE_SAFETY', 'NBC 3.2.3.1', '{"required":{"residential":{"area":5000,"storeys":5},"commercial":{"area":2000,"storeys":3},"industrial":{"area":3000,"storeys":2}},"notes":"Sprinklers reduce required fire rating"}', true, NOW(), 1, 1),
('FS-003', 'NBC_2025', 'Canada', 'Fire Separation Requirements', 'Minimum fire-resistance rating for separations between occupancies.', 'FIRE_SAFETY', 'NBC 3.1.8.1', '{"fireRating":{"sameOccupancy":0,"differentOccupancy":2},"notes":"Fire rating in hours"}', true, NOW(), 1, 1),
('FS-004', 'NBC_2025', 'Canada', 'Emergency Lighting Requirements', 'Emergency lighting required in exit routes and areas of refuge.', 'FIRE_SAFETY', 'NBC 3.2.5.1', '{"minIllumination":50,"duration":90,"coverage":["exits","corridors","stairs","emergency_exits"]}', true, NOW(), 1, 1);
